terrain.source: NASA/USGS SRTM v3 via Open Topo Data

soil.message: No verified local soil pH or texture is available. Wetness, humidity and vegetation are not soil chemistry or fertility measurements.

method.name: TerraGrow transparent range screen; not an official FAO/GAEZ score
method.rule: Linear membership: 100 inside the published optimal range, tapering to 0 at absolute limits. Annual mean temperature and annual rainfall use FAO GAEZ climate normals where available, or an explicitly labelled NASA fallback. An altitude-only absolute ceiling is a binary constraint. Known absolute violations constrain the score to 0. Missing factors are excluded, never counted as matches. Both temperature and annual rainfall are required to rank. Thresholds and weights are transparent app choices, not FAO classifications.
method.confidence_note: A score describes match on available factors, not harvest success or confidence. Missing soil pH, texture and management prevent a verified field recommendation.

crops.name: Arabica coffee
crops.image_kind: Crop illustration, not a photo of your field

water.basis: FAO training manual Tables 4 and 5: approximate growing period and crop evapotranspiration; not irrigation volume or annual rainfall.

duration.basis: FAO ECOCROP species crop-cycle range

season.basis: Estimated climatological planning window, not a verified Lao planting calendar or a rain forecast.
season.method: For each start month, use the midpoint of the sourced FAO growing-period guide. Require all monthly mean temperatures to be within absolute limits, average temperature membership at least 80/100, and gross rainfall over that period at least the lower FAO seasonal water guide. Effective rainfall, runoff, irrigation, rice flooding losses and varieties are not established.

source.name: FAO ECOCROP
source.database_note: Historical FAO ECOCROP database, discontinued around 2015; source sheet is undated.

notes: GAEZ coffee is a crop group and does not distinguish Arabica and Robusta; use its result only as additional regional context.
crops.gaez_scope: Coffee group, not a species-specific check

limitations: Estimated environmental match, not verified local agricultural advice.
No direct satellite measurement of soil fertility is used. Soil chemistry and field management require local checks.
Species ranges do not establish cultivar performance. Annual rainfall is not available irrigation water.
Nearby pins can share climate-grid values. Rankings are allowed to remain equal when evidence is equal.
Scores are not harvest probabilities. Harvest success is not guaranteed.
